goal: UNI-3306 PR 3: a daily 90-day clean-up of goal analysis jobs. Finished and failed jobs are deleted 90 days after ended_at by a SQL function on the database clock, in bounded batches; queued, running and interrupted jobs are never deleted; a failed call is an error, never 'deleted 0'; triggered daily by the live in-process cron_loop.

criteria.text: The store method and the clean-up handler pass their unit tests on the existing fake: purge_ended returns the database's deleted count, rejects a limit outside 1..1000, raises (never returns 0) when the function or table is missing or the reply is malformed; the handler loops in bounded batches, logs and re-raises a store failure, and the cron row goal-jobs-cleanup-daily is enabled, daily, and resolves to the handler.
